name: cloudpilot
description: Official CloudPilot documentation and read-only cluster guidance.

interface.longDescription: Understand CloudPilot product fields and behavior using official documentation. Connect your CloudPilot account to inspect cluster health, optimization status, nodes, NodePools, costs, and alerts through read-only MCP tools. Live data requires authorization and the relevant organization permissions. This plugin does not change settings or perform cluster operations.
defaultPrompt: What does minNonSpotReplicas mean in CloudPilot?
How do CPU used, requested, allocatable, and provisioned differ?
Help me check the health and optimization status of my selected cluster.
